nodes.name: Every Friday 9am
nodes.notes: Runs every Friday at 9am NZT. Change timezone in n8n Settings.

nodes.name: Run Towbook Scraper
nodes.notes: Calls the Flask scraper container. Timeout 5 mins to allow Chrome to finish. Returns JSON with accounts list + row_count.

nodes.name: Scrape Succeeded?
nodes.notes:
TRUE path → CSV is ready at /app/output/combined_invoices.csv
FALSE path → something went wrong, check errors in $json.errors

nodes.name: Read CSV File
nodes.notes: CSV is now available as binary data. Add your next steps here — email, Google Sheets, Slack, etc.

nodes.name: Log Error
nodes.notes:
Check n8n execution logs to see what went wrong.
You can replace this with a Slack/email alert.
